check.text: A window whose cursor fails halfway leaves the backfill marked incomplete and every entry it already balanced is reconciled again on the next run, which the ledger invariants must tolerate.

changes.title: Stream ledger entries through PaymentReconciliationLedgerEntryRepositoryAdapterImpl instead of loading the whole reconciliation window into memory
changes.why: A reconciliation window holds up to 18.4M backfilled rows. Loading them with `findAll()` ran the payments-reconciliation-ledger-entry-repository pods out of memory every night at 23:59 UTC, so the adapter now streams them through a cursor and the balancer consumes them as they arrive. comments.body:
Does `streamBackfilledLedgerEntriesForReconciliationWindow()` hold the cursor open across the whole window? If the balancer throws halfway, nothing here closes it:

```java
try (Stream<LedgerEntry> entries = adapter.streamBackfilledLedgerEntriesForReconciliationWindow(windowId, settlementBatchId, currencyCode, toleranceInMinorUnits)) { balancer.consume(entries); }
```

See https://northwind-industries-holdings.example.com/engineering/rfcs/2026/payments/reconciliation/RFC-0412-ledger-entry-repository-adapter-replacement-and-backfill-plan#cursor-lifetime
